'''Silversear''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Nekoflare]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Cinderclaw]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "In Silversear's eyes, the Tatari at camp are little more than noisy troublemakers. Without Silversear standing guard, these fools who can't even tell jewels from pinballs might not live to see the next sunrise."

Silversear is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A dark gray-blue cat with a single snaggletooth that wears a red- and white-striped rope around its waist. It hovers in the air and holds an orange orb with a flame symbol in one paw. It has a fiery red mane, and its inner ears and long tail are also red. Additionally, it has yellow eyes with red pupils and a white lower face.

Silversear's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with bright pink, and its gray-blue fur becomes gray-teal.

== Evolution Trial ==
Silversear's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Cinderclaw]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

*Feed this Tatari to B quality.
*Use Energy Drink x20,000.
*Launch 40,000 pinballs or unlock [[Thunderpaw]]'s codex.

==Strategy==
[[File:Silversear Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Silversear's attack range]]
You should use [[Kittazap]]/evo alongside Silversear because of the Paw Pals bond.
